entries.displayName: KV-cache size per model (derived from config.json)
entries.description: Per-model KV-cache bytes per token derived from each open model's published config.json, with the source commit. Rows where the config does not say which layers hold a KV cache are left blank.
representativeQueries: how much KV cache memory does Llama 3.1 8B need per token
KV cache bytes per token for open models
which open models have the smallest KV cache

entries.displayName: KV Cache and GPU Memory Calculator
entries.description: Browser-only calculator: weights, KV cache, gradients, optimizer states and activations for LLM inference and training against a GPU's memory. Input stays in the browser.
representativeQueries: will this model fit in my GPU memory
KV cache VRAM calculator for 32K context
how much VRAM does a 70B model need for inference

entries.displayName: Measured: what fits on a 6 GB GPU
entries.description: Measured llama.cpp runs on one RTX 3050 6 GB laptop GPU: 5 local models, 4K, 32K and 128K windows, f16 and q8_0 KV cache. Each cell is marked fits, spills or out of memory, with the memory the log reported.
representativeQueries: what local LLM fits on a 6GB GPU
does Llama 3.1 8B run at 32K context on 6GB VRAM
measured llama.cpp memory use at 128K context
